units.name: 오크 주술사
units.bodyDescription: 오크 표준 뼈대 · 숙인 고개 · 하이앵글 프론트뷰
units.prompt: Rebuild ONE complete production transparent PIXEL game token. INPUT1 original character controls EXACT costume/hair/helmet/beard/palette/weapons, elevated FRONT camera, deeply BOWED hidden face and distinct action silhouette; preserve those identity details. INPUT2 neutral ORC species skeleton controls EXACT FIVE anatomical crown-to-chin heads for crown-to-sole body, ordinary adult skull and shoulder/pelvis/knee/ankle bone lengths, crisp pixel density/stepped dark outlines/short restrained shade ramps. Redress and rotate original neutral bones into INPUT1 action, NEVER lengthen to6–8heads, shrink to4heads or inflate helmet/skull. Slim/muscular/fat changes WIDTH only. Elevated front camera down40–45degrees with crown and both shoulder TOPS obvious, torso/face foreshortened. Head firmly tucked down, eyes covered by hair/helmet/hood/brow; NO frontal facial portrait/eye contact. Retain original body's forward lean or combat action. Do not default to template's walking pose: grounded/braced feet or original lunging as equipment/action warrants, varied lead foot, uncrossed coherent limbs. Complete exact original weapons with logical handgrips; no weapons borrowed from INPUT2. Full silhouette and ALL weapon/banner/antler tips inside INNER80percent canvas. Body center ignores equipment. Transparent background, no base/floor/shadow/scenery/text/watermark/extra figures. Character identity: 오크 주술사 (orc_shaman). EXACT original loadout/palette/materials/action from INPUT1. Use ORIGINAL ORC bone proportions exactly; preserve original larger muscle WIDTH for Bolg/Azog and exact claws/prosthetic weapon.
